title: Patient Cost-Share Protections Schedule: Caps, Deductibles and the Payment Plan Notice under Prescription Insurance on File
content:
The patient's share of a claim under **Prescription Insurance on File** is shaped by class-level protections: a per-claim patient-pay cap, dispensing when the copay cannot be paid, an annual out-of-pocket cap, the pharmacy deductible and its preventive-drug waiver, and the Medicare Prescription Payment Plan with its notice threshold. Amounts are in US dollars; where a setting does not apply the amount is shown as 0.00.

## Per-claim and annual protections

| Plan class | Per-claim patient-pay cap applies | Per-claim cap (USD) | Dispense even if copay unpaid | Annual out-of-pocket cap applies | Annual out-of-pocket cap (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medicaid Managed Care Pharmacy Benefit | Yes | 8.00 | Yes | No | 0.00 |
| Medicare Part D Standard Plan | No | 0.00 | No | Yes | 2100.00 |
| Medicare Part D Enhanced Plan | No | 0.00 | No | Yes | 2100.00 |
| Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Plan | No | 0.00 | No | Yes | 2100.00 |
| Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan | No | 0.00 | No | No | 0.00 |
| Commercial Copay Plan | No | 0.00 | No | No | 0.00 |
| Workers' Compensation Pharmacy Benefit | Yes | 0.00 | No | No | 0.00 |

## Deductible and payment plan

| Plan class | Pharmacy deductible phase | Preventive list bypasses deductible | Medicare Prescription Payment Plan offered | Payment plan notice threshold (USD, single paid claim) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medicaid Managed Care Pharmacy Benefit | No | No | No | 0.00 |
| Medicare Part D Standard Plan | Yes | No | Yes | 600.00 |
| Medicare Part D Enhanced Plan | No | No | Yes | 600.00 |
| Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Plan | Yes | No | Yes | 600.00 |
| Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan | Yes | Yes | No | 0.00 |
| Commercial Copay Plan | No | No | No | 0.00 |
| Workers' Compensation Pharmacy Benefit | No | No | No | 0.00 |

## Definitions

- **Per-claim patient-pay cap** — whether a per-claim patient-pay cap applies, and the cap where it applies.
- **Dispense even if copay unpaid** — whether a covered fill must be dispensed even when the patient cannot pay the copay.
- **Annual out-of-pocket cap** — whether an annual out-of-pocket cap on covered drugs applies, and the cap where it applies.
- **Pharmacy deductible phase** — whether claims may be subject to a pharmacy deductible.
- **Preventive list bypasses deductible** — whether drugs on the plan's preventive list bypass the deductible.
- **Payment plan notice threshold** — the patient pay on a single paid claim at or above which Kestrel gives the payment plan notice.

## Points to note

- The Workers' Compensation Pharmacy Benefit applies a per-claim cap of 0.00, so the patient pays nothing on a claim; the Medicaid Managed Care Pharmacy Benefit caps the patient at 8.00 per claim.
- The Medicare Part D Enhanced Plan is the only Medicare class without a deductible phase.
- Only the Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan lets preventive-list drugs bypass its deductible.
